item.title: langchain 1.5.0 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: **`langchain` 1.5.0 drops support for Python 3.10**, which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11, and the minimum `langchain-core` version is now 1.8.0. Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve `langchain` 1.4.x. Release notes: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/langchain%3D%3D1.5.0

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.321 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree Quote: - Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay Quote: - Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321
